profile.headline: Senior AI Systems Engineer @ Vortex MSP | I build custom AI agents that run real work | I sit at the intersection of AI and Infrastructure | Claude · Copilot · M365 · Azure · Intune · Purview · Foundry | InfoSec
profile.summary:
I have been in IT for 25 years. Certified Azure engineer and architect, two-time Microsoft MVP, founder of Tech Innovation Labs. The last several of those years I have spent turning frontier models into systems that actually run business workflows, which is a harder problem than the demos make it look.  

Most of what gets labeled AI in this industry is a chatbot pointed at a knowledge base. The work I do is agentic systems on Claude, GPT, and Gemini, with tool use, MCP integrations, and multi-agent orchestration wired into real processes, which means error handling, logging, and a security review, because an agent holding credentials is an identity and I treat it like one.  That sits on top of the consulting practice, and the two feed each other. 

Assessments, roadmaps, migrations, governance, and advanced security across Azure and M365. Infrastructure as Code, so an environment is something you rebuild instead of something you remember. Compliance handled before an auditor asks for it. Costs cut by fixing the architecture (renegotiating licenses buys you a year, and then you are back where you started).  

I also write the code. TypeScript, serverless on Azure, CI/CD, production AI pipelines that go from prototype to deployed product without a rewrite in the middle. I build the automation I recommend, and I secure it the same way I secure everything else.  My clients are lean startups, global enterprises, and a lot of things in between. What they have in common is complexity nobody has had time to simplify and manual work that should have been automated years ago.  

If you are working out where AI genuinely fits in your environment, or you have infrastructure that keeps breaking in the same place, message me. I'm also always up for a good argument about Zero Trust.

positions.title: Senior Cloud Architect
positions.description:
I engage with customers during the pre-sales process to understand their challenges and goals in using cloud technologies. Responsible for the design of the cloud from a strategical perspective to ensure it meets the needs of the business.

These engagements can include cloud assessments, architectural design workshops, whiteboard sessions, workload migration design, overcoming blockers, development of migration roadmap and leading deployments.

positions.title: Architect & Principal Consultant
positions.description:
Responsible for technical pre-sales design and delivery of solutions focused on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager, and Enterprise Mobility Suite. 
Driving complex selling process by removing blockers at the BDM and TDM level. 
Communicating complex concepts in simple terms to demonstrate business value.

positions.title: Distinguished Technical Solutions Professional
positions.description: As part of the sales team, I am responsible for the technical aspect of our sales success. Through evangelizing and deep technical discussions with our customers, I help remove technical blockers in the customers mind. Through my years of experience with Azure, System Center and related technologies, I am able to demonstrate to our customers that they can be successful with our solutions. As the SME for Microsoft technologies, I lead the technical efforts in our largest accounts with a particular focus on System Center and Azure.  I also function as a Microsoft V-TSP.

positions.title: Microsoft Architect
positions.description: Designed and delivered Microsoft Azure and System Center solutions based solutions.  Including, Azure cloud architecture designs and migrations, Microsoft Intune / EMS based mobility solutions, System Center designs.  Responsible for all stages of the customer technical engagement for Azure, Azure Pack, EMS, SCCM, SCOM, SCORCH.

positions.title: Principal Solutions Engineer - Large Enterprise
positions.description:
Articulate the overall Symantec Information Management value proposition, vision and strategy to customers and partners.  
Map customer IT strategies to technical requirements and then to workable Symantec solution architectures.  
Collaboratively develop and articulate an end-to-end solution design, inclusive of consulting support and education.  
Provide focused leadership across technology area to drive initiatives with virtual teams.  
Translate customer business requirements into integrated technical solutions.  
Identify and execute assessment-led selling opportunities.  
Solution selling of all offerings within the Symantec Portfolio.   
Provide customer with complete solution designs which may include 3rd-party products.  
Articulate and document how Symantec solutions provide increased business value and improved technical capability when compared to competitors.  
Assist in technically closing complex and competitive opportunities through advanced competitive knowledge, technical skills, and credibility.  
Recognized as a thought leader and source of advice for other functions.  
Deliver product and technology briefings.  
Train, mentor, and collaborate with Technical Sales Organization peers.  
Proactively engage and communicate with the Product Teams, Business Units, Marketing and Sales.

positions.title: Principal Solutions Engineer
positions.description: Technical presales solution engineer responsible for the western US, named US accounts, and global high profile accounts. Responsible for managing the sales process from the start of the technical process until the solution proved it could meet the customer's goals.  Customers were mostly Fortune 500 companies with highly complex infrastructures that could have 50K - 750K endpoints.

positions.title: Senior Technical Consultant
positions.description: Senior Technical Consultant with Dimension Data, working with Microsoft SMS 2003, MOM 2005, BDD, OSD, Zero Touch Installation, Group Policy, Active Directory, Microsoft Virtual Server, all in an effort to help customers mange and deploy operating systems, install software packages, get to 100% patch management, and maintain a healthy computing environment.

positions.title: Senior Infrastructure Architect
positions.description:
Datacenter Wintel Architect, VMware Architect. 
Wintel Server Capacity Planning, Budgeting and Vendor Management. 
Worked directly with Development and Services departments to ensure server and virtualization needs were met.
Clustering, Active Directory, Group Policy, Terminal Server, IIS, SQL, Performance Monitoring,  SAN, NAS, DFS, Project Manager, InfoSec administration.
